description:
Functional specifications/files: lib/zaq/accounts/people.ex and person_identities.ex only as required by the approved contract. Replace WhatsApp phone conflict and stored-placeholder rules with generic evidence-driven persistence; remove provider-specific moduledoc claims. Preserve Repo transaction/retry boundaries, protected merge behavior and channel ownership. Audit every direct find_or_create_from_channel caller for compatible defaults.
Tests to add before implementation: extend accounts/channel_identity_test.exs, connector_person_discovery_test.exs, channel_identity_concurrency_test.exs and people tests. Cover generic enrichment-only phone, authoritative conflicting owners, preservation of explicit edits, atomic link/backfill rollback, races and safe invalid-evidence defaults. Use properties for replacement eligibility and ownership invariants.
Branches/paths validated: insert/match, connector/unscoped compatibility, email conflict, enrichment phone versus identity evidence, existing user edits, failed linking and retry. No provider-specific parsing, names, flags or callbacks in generic People logic. Do not broaden phone matching semantics for other providers accidentally.
Documentations: People and PersonIdentities module contracts and appropriate existing service owner.
Action reuse assessment: extend People.find_or_create_from_channel/2 and existing update changesets; reuse PersonIdentities.lookup/claim and existing transaction ownership. Inputs trusted canonical discovery evidence; outputs {:ok, person} or controlled errors; all writes rollback on conflicts. Current callers retain authorization responsibilities; no permission bypass or new agent/tool exposure. No parallel discovery Action. Verify through real DB transactions and caller integration.
Policies: read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable module/service guidance before implementation. For sibling changes read ../jido_chat_whatsapp/AGENTS.md. Follow the authoritative validation lifecycle; preserve existing assertions. No commits, pushes or merges are authorized by this plan.
Mocking plan: keep internal modules and database boundaries real; isolate external transport at its existing contract, with connection-scoped offline fixtures. Avoid global configuration mutation.
E2E: no new UI or user journey; unit, property and thin integration tests provide the required coverage. Reassess if scope changes.

Scope correction from user: this integration has not shipped. Remove obsolete legacy-JID repair branches and update/remove the test dedicated solely to historical repair. This is an intentional scope change, not permission to weaken active-contract tests. Retain tests for late enrichment of newly created incomplete profiles, missing names/phones, and preservation of explicit edits. No migration or historical data cleanup is required.

Implementation constraint confirmed with user: add no new ZAQ modules. Extend existing module responsibilities and existing canonical maps/callbacks. Do not introduce a discovery policy module, profile evidence module, wrapper Action, or provider-specific helper under People. Keep the contract minimal and document it in existing owners. If implementation evidence makes this constraint impossible, explain the concrete conflict before changing the agreed scope.

comments.text: Implemented in People: removed WhatsApp-specific phone conflict and stored JID/name parsing; generic profile_phone enriches without claiming identity, explicit phone still conflicts. Generated name replacement is generic and profile edits retained. Added Mattermost two-authority same-profile-phone test. Existing direct-phone conflict test passes.

title: [zaq-10n.4] Apply provider-neutral discovery and profile persistence in People
